content.query:
Usage
| where TimeGenerated > startofday({TimeRange:start}) and TimeGenerated < startofday({TimeRange:end})
| where IsBillable == true
| extend Plan = case(column_ifexists("Plan", "") in~ ("Auxiliary", "DataLake", "Data Lake"), "Data Lake", column_ifexists("Plan", "") =~ "Basic", "Basic", "Analytics")
| where Plan == "Analytics"
| summarize GB = sum(Quantity)/1024 by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| summarize ['Analytics GBs/day'] = round(avg(GB), 2)
| extend ['Analytics GBs/day'] = iff(isnull(['Analytics GBs/day']) or isnan(['Analytics GBs/day']), 0.0, ['Analytics GBs/day'])
content.title: Avg billable GB/day - Analytics

content.query:
let _BasicPrice = 1.0;      // Basic tier $/GB - set your regional rate
let byPlan = Usage
| where IsBillable == true
| extend Plan = case(column_ifexists("Plan", "") in~ ("Auxiliary", "DataLake", "Data Lake"), "Data Lake", column_ifexists("Plan", "") =~ "Basic", "Basic", "Analytics")
| extend UnitPrice = case(Plan == "Data Lake", toreal({DataLakePrice}), Plan == "Basic", _BasicPrice, toreal({Price}))
| summarize size = sum(Quantity)/1024, cost = sum(Quantity/1024*UnitPrice) by Plan;
union byPlan, (byPlan | summarize size = sum(size), cost = sum(cost) | extend Plan = "Total")
| extend o = case(Plan=="Total",0, Plan=="Analytics",1, Plan=="Basic",2, 3)
| order by o asc
| project Plan, ['Total data ingestion'] = size, ['Estimated cost'] = cost
content.title: Billable ingestion & estimated cost by plan ({TimeRange:label})

## Microsoft Sentinel benefit for Microsoft 365 E5, A5, F5 and G5 customers With security information and event management (SIEM) and extended detection and response (XDR) from Microsoft, you’re armed with the context and automation you need to stop sophisticated, cross-domain attacks across your entire organization. Microsoft 365 E5, A5, F5, G5 and Microsoft 365 E5, A5, F5, G5 Security customers can get data grant up to 5MB per user/day of Microsoft 365 data ingestion into Microsoft Sentinel.

"SecurityBaseline",

"MDCFileIntegrityMonitoringEvents")
